Package com.csse3200.game.components.attacks

Class ChargeComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.attacks.ChargeComponent
public class ChargeComponent extends Component
Represents a temporary charge state. A charge has two phases: in the windup the entity stands still, and in the rush it moves fast toward a snapshot of the target's position with its TouchAttackComponent live. Touching the target during the rush deals the entity's base attack times the damage multiplier, once per rush, and (by default) ends the rush so the entity does not run through the player. The rush is the attack, so there is exactly one damage event per charge and no double-dipping with a separate attack.

Attack-type-agnostic: Minotaur and Centaur both use it. If the entity has no TouchAttackComponent the charge still moves the entity but deals no damage.

Fires "chargeStart", "chargeWindupStart", "chargeRushStart" and "chargeEnd" on the entity.

  • Constructor Details

    • ChargeComponent

      public ChargeComponent(float chargeDuration, float cooldown, float damageMultiplier, float speedMultiplier) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Create a charge component without a wind-up phase — moves fast immediately.
      Parameters:
      chargeDuration - seconds a single charge lasts once started
      cooldown - minimum seconds between the end of one charge and the start of the next
      damageMultiplier - damage multiplier applied to the next attack while charging; must be greater than 1.0
      speedMultiplier - movement speed multiplier applied while charging; must be greater than 1.0
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if constraints are violated

    • ChargeComponent

      public ChargeComponent(float chargeDuration, float windupDuration, float cooldown, float damageMultiplier, float speedMultiplier) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Create a charge component with an optional stationary wind-up phase before the fast rush.
      Parameters:
      chargeDuration - total seconds a charge lasts (including windupDuration)
      windupDuration - seconds the entity remains stationary winding up before moving fast
      cooldown - minimum seconds between the end of one charge and the start of the next
      damageMultiplier - damage multiplier applied to the next attack while charging; must be greater than 1.0
      speedMultiplier - movement speed multiplier applied while charging; must be greater than 1.0
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if constraints are violated

    • startCharge

      public void startCharge(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 targetPosition)
      Begins a charge toward the given target position if canCharge() is true; otherwise a no-op. If windupDuration > 0, the entity remains stationary during the windup phase before moving fast toward the target position.
      Parameters:
      targetPosition - the world position to charge toward

    • getDamageMultiplier

      public float getDamageMultiplier()
      Returns the damage multiplier to apply to the next attack. Safe to call unconditionally — returns 1.0f (no change) whenever not currently charging, so callers never need to check isCharging() first.
      Returns:
      damageMultiplier while charging, otherwise 1.0f. No damage is dealt by this method.

    • onMovementBlocked

      public void onMovementBlocked()
      Ends the current charge early when the entity's walk was vetoed, for example at the edge of a hazard. Only a rush is cut short: a windup is stationary anyway, and an idle component has nothing to end.
